items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: That was the night that we did "Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue and Paul Gonsalves went out there and played 27 choruses.

ctx.x: Because this band was so fantastic. I want to talk about the concert we did at Newport in '56 which to me was history. We had 10,000 people there and I never seen people go crazy. That was the night that we did "Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue and Paul Gonsalves went out there and played 27 choruses. By the time we got to the end the whole place was in mayhem, 10,000 people.
